author: Justin Miro
text: Everyone there including the owner is so friendly, nice, and they explain everything .  They installed the septic tank system for my house about 3 years ago, and they have been so good to us with everything.  I would definitely recommend them to anyone.  They are great.

author: Stella Bagwell
text:
This company gave us excellent service for our septic system that I would highly recommend. The technician, Cannon, was super knowledgeable, polite, and very likable. He and the guy who pumped the tank were really nice about explaining everything---the best personalities you'll encounter. Septic iQ kept us informed about the repairs we needed during the day. All in all, we were highly satisfied with their work and would certainly use them again if needed.
Thank you, Septic iQ for a fantastic job!

author: A Cold Corpse
text: Service here is easily 5 stars. Cannon is a former neighbor of mine who I grew up all the way through graduation with. This is the type of person you want to show up. Calm, friendly mannerisms and very well spoken. Approachable and easy to hold conversation with. Everything he communicated to us left us not needing to ask questions. The company has been exceptional.

author: Hilde Howard
text: I highly recommend Septic IQ for any septic work and maintenance of your system. They do a great job at reasonable prices. Their team is top notch, specifically their Tech Cannon. He is courteous, respectful, and kind. Hunter as well.

author: Brianna Garner
text: Very knowledgeable!!! I appreciate the time and knowledge he provided me! Provided me with solutions and do/donts
